en.headline: Disgusting Food Museum continues at Kai Tak AIRSIDE until late November
en.dek: The Swedish exhibition of more than 80 polarising foods from around the world is open at GATE33 Gallery in AIRSIDE, with interactive displays and a tasting bar.
body: The Disgusting Food Museum, originally from Malmö in Sweden, is running at GATE33 Gallery on the third floor of AIRSIDE in Kai Tak until 26 November.

The organisers said the show brings together more than 80 foods from 35 countries across five themed zones, using real items, models, scent installations and interactive elements. Visitors receive a vomit bag on entry.
A tasting bar allows those who wish to try selected items under staff guidance. Opening hours are noon to 7pm from Monday to Thursday, and 11am to 8pm from Friday to Sunday, according to the venue.
Adult tickets start from HK$68 on weekdays. The exhibition first opened in Hong Kong on 29 September.

zh.headline: 嘔心食物博物館啟德AIRSIDE展至十一月底
zh.dek: 來自瑞典的展覽在啟德AIRSIDE GATE33藝文館展出逾80款各地爭議性食物，設互動展區及試食吧，展期至11月26日。
body: 來自瑞典馬爾默的《嘔心食物博物館》現正於啟德AIRSIDE三樓GATE33藝文館舉行，展期至11月26日。
主辦方表示，展覽搜羅來自35個國家逾80款食物，分為五大主題區域，結合實物、模型、氣味裝置及互動元素。入場人士會獲發嘔吐袋。
場內設有試食吧，願意挑戰的參觀者可在工作人員指導下嘗試部分食材。場地資料顯示，開放時間為周一至周四中午12時至晚上7時，周五至周日上午11時至晚上8時。
成人門票平日由68元起。展覽於9月29日在香港首度開放。
